name: Pendry San Diego
positioning: The first Pendry hotel, in downtown San Diego's Historic Gaslamp Quarter, with an urban coastal California look and a rooftop wellness floor
best_for: Travelers who want to stay in the Gaslamp Quarter, close to the Convention Center and Petco Park
Guests who want a rooftop pool, spa and gym in a city hotel

facts.text: Pendry San Diego is located downtown in the heart of the Historic Gaslamp Quarter.
The hotel is just blocks from the San Diego Convention Center and Petco Park.
The guestrooms and suites have an urban coastal California aesthetic.
Guestrooms have custom furnishings and views of the bay and downtown.
Bathrooms have glass-walled walk-in showers lined with subway tiles.
At Spa Pendry, guests can book a facial, massage, sound bath or IV treatment.
The fitness center is open 24/7, with equipment including Peloton and TechnoGym.
The Pool House is an open-air rooftop lounge perched above the Gaslamp's 5th Avenue.
Lionfish serves modern coastal cuisine, including sushi and seafood, in a two-floor dining room.
Guests find chocolates on their pillow each night.
Pendry was launched by the father-and-son duo Alan and Michael Fuerstman.

highlights.text: Pendry San Diego was the very first Pendry, opened in 2017 as the brand's flagship.
A wellness floor brings together the gym, the spa and the rooftop pool.
Rooms are labeled by view, so guests can pick a skyline, bay, city or pool outlook.
Suites have ocean-inspired interiors with warm blue wall coverings and a chaise lounge in classic tartan fabric.
Nason's Beer Hall is named after Nason & Co. Farmer's Market, which occupied the same space in the early 1900s.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the downtown location can be busy and noisy at peak times.
Spa Pendry is a rooftop spa that welcomes locals as well as hotel guests.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
